subject: Life Skills
title: Forgiveness Is Not Forgetting
description: Learn Forgiveness Is Not Forgetting in one minute.

hook.text: People who forgive experience lower blood pressure and fewer depressive symptoms, studies consistently show.

buildup.text: Holding a grudge keeps your body in a stress state. The cortisol meant for danger runs constantly.

discovery.text: Forgiveness is releasing the desire for revenge. It doesn't mean condoning, excusing, or reconciling.

twist.text: You can forgive someone and still maintain firm boundaries. Forgiveness protects your health, not their comfort.

climax.text: Forgiveness is a process, not a moment. It may take weeks or years, and that is completely normal.

punchline.text: Forgive for yourself. Boundaries protect the rest.

quiz.question: What does forgiveness NOT require?
options: Condoning the behavior or dropping boundaries
